common.notValuationEngine: The platform tracks figures supplied by people or imported from the original models. It is not a valuation engine: it never invents amounts, rates or approvals, and it never adds amounts in different currencies or units without an explicit, disclosed basis.
common.clearanceNote: Your finance clearance is {clearance}: records classified above it are not listed, counted or totalled for you.
common.noCommands: No command is available to you in the current state.
common.classificationHint: Proposed default for this record type: {proposed}. You can only choose a level within your clearance.
common.raiseOnly: A classification can be raised here; lowering it is a declassification decision outside this form.
common.tsaNotVisible: The linked TSA service is not visible to you.
common.cellHint: As written in the workbook: B12, $B$12, B12:D12 or a named range.
common.cellInvalid: Use a cell such as B12, $B$12, B12:D12 or a named range.
common.evidenceAboveClearance: Evidence for this record is managed in the Document & Evidence Center under your general clearance ({clearance}). This record is classified {classification}, so its evidence is not available to you here.
common.historyUnavailable: The activity history of this record is not available to you here: the project activity feed applies your general clearance ({clearance}) and does not yet list every finance record type. The record’s own validation and approval trail is shown on this page.

money.amountInvalid: Enter a decimal number (up to 4 decimals), e.g. 1250.50.
money.currencyInvalid: Enter a three-letter ISO currency code, e.g. SAR.
money.hint: Amount, currency and unit are recorded exactly as entered; nothing is converted.

sod.youPrepared: You prepared this content. Separation of duties: another Finance member validates it and a third person approves it.
sod.youValidated: You validated this content. Separation of duties: a third person — neither the preparer nor the validator — approves it.
sod.validationStale: The content changed after its validation: it has to be validated again before it can be approved.
sod.youCreatedBenefit: You registered this benefit: an independent Finance reviewer accepts it into the register.
sod.youOwnBenefit: You own this benefit: acceptance and verification are done by someone independent of the owner.
sod.youReported: You reported this realization: someone independent of the reporter verifies or rejects it.

approval.title: Human financial validation and approval
approval.validationCurrent: The validation covers the current content.
approval.validationStale: The content changed after this validation — validate it again.
approval.ruleValidate: Validation: a Finance member (financial validation permission) who did not prepare the content.
approval.ruleApprove: Approval: a third person — neither the preparer nor the validator — approves the validated content.
approval.ruleHuman: Validation and approval are human acts: the worker and the AI runtime can never perform them.
approval.noCommands: No validation or approval command is available to you for this record in its current state.

summary.title: Finance & Value
summary.subtitle: Budget, commitments, costs, reference balances, models and benefits — every figure with its currency, unit, period and source.
summary.perCurrencyNote: Each row is one currency and unit, as grouped by the server. Rows are never added together; use the total calculator below with an explicit conversion basis. “Approved” adds only the approved amounts recorded so far — a line without an approved budget adds nothing (see the budget list).
summary.noFindings: No possible double counting found in the figures you can see.
summary.findingsHint: A line reference recorded under several categories is reported here as possible double counting.

aggregate.title: Total calculator (server aggregation)
aggregate.explain: The server adds the figures you select. Baseline, forecast and actual figures are never added together. Figures in different currencies need an explicit conversion basis (rate, source and rate date) supplied by you; figures in different units need an explicit normalization. The basis of every total is shown.
aggregate.targetCurrencyHint: Leave empty to use the currency of the first figure.
aggregate.normalizeHint: Explicit opt-in: figures in units, thousands and millions are brought to one unit; the normalization is disclosed with the total.
aggregate.conversionsHint: Supplied by you from an approved rate source — the platform never invents a rate. 1 unit of the “from” currency = rate × the “to” currency.
aggregate.noBasisTitle: Total refused: different currencies without a conversion basis
aggregate.noBasisBody: The selected figures include amounts in {from} that cannot be added to {to} without an explicit conversion basis. Add the rate, its source and its date, or narrow the selection to one currency.
aggregate.unitsBody: The selected figures are expressed in different units ({scales}). Normalize the units explicitly or narrow the selection.
aggregate.nothing: No figure matches this selection, so there is nothing to total.
aggregate.mixedKinds: Baseline, forecast and actual figures are never added together: select figures of one kind.

snapshots.title: Figures
snapshots.subtitle: Baseline, forecast and actual figures with currency, unit, period, source and approval date. Validation by a second person precedes approval by a third.
snapshots.search: Search figures by line reference or label
snapshots.lineRefHint: Stable reference of the line (letters, digits and . _ : / -); one line keeps one category.
snapshots.lineRefInvalid: Use letters, digits and . _ : / - only (up to 64 characters).
snapshots.label: Label
snapshots.periodInvalid: Use one of the formats shown.
snapshots.sourceHint: Where the figure comes from (report, ledger extract, model output). Required unless a source document is linked.
snapshots.selectionHint: Select figures to total them through the server; the selection is kept across pages.
snapshots.emptyHint: Record a figure with its source, or import the outputs of an original model.
snapshots.tsaHint: A TSA charge is linked to exactly the TSA service it is charged for, so it is counted once.

create.title: Record a figure
create.hint: The figure starts as proposed. Currency, unit, period and source are mandatory; the amount is recorded as entered.

import.title: Import outputs of an original model
import.hint: Each imported figure keeps the source document, the sheet and the cell it came from. The import is all-or-nothing and never overwrites an existing figure.
import.tsaNote: TSA charges are recorded one by one (they must be linked to their TSA service).
import.done: {count} figure(s) imported with their source references.

edit.title: Edit figure {line}
edit.hint: A change to the content of a validated figure withdraws the validation: it returns to proposed and must be validated again.
edit.importedHint: An imported figure keeps the value and source of its model output: import the corrected output instead. Only the workstream and classification can change here.
edit.invalidated: Saved — the validation no longer applies (now {state}).

validate.title: Validate figure {line}
validate.note: Validation note (what was checked, against which source)
validate.effect: Records your human financial validation of the current content and opens an approval request.
validate.sod: You cannot validate content you prepared; a third person approves it.
validate.done: Validated — an approval request is open.

approve.title: Approve figure {line}
approve.effect: Approves the validated content; the approval is recorded with its date and stays in the history.
approve.sod: The approver is neither the preparer nor the validator.
approve.openingBalance: An opening balance is approved by the authorized body: link its final opening balance sheet governance decision.

reject.title: Reject figure {line}
reject.effect: Rejects the validated content; it can be corrected and validated again.

reopen.title: Reopen figure {line}
reopen.effect: Returns the approved figure to proposed for correction; the approval stays in the history and a fresh validation and approval are needed.

decision.types: Accepted decision types: {types}. Only a final decision is accepted (checked by the server).
decision.noneAvailable: No decision of an accepted type is available in this project.
decision.notVisible: Governance decisions are not visible to you.

budget.title: Budget
budget.subtitle: Budget lines with approved, committed and spent amounts kept separate, in each line's own currency and unit.
budget.search: Search budget lines by code or name
budget.name: Name
budget.proposedIn: Proposed amount ({currency}, in the line's unit)
budget.emptySearch: No budget lines match these filters.
budget.positionNote: All amounts of this line are in {currency}, {unit}.
budget.convention: Convention (to be confirmed by Finance): committed includes the part already spent; open commitment = committed − spent; uncommitted budget = approved − committed.
budget.approvedByDecision: The approved amount is recorded only from a final governance decision (baseline, budget change or spend commitment) — never set here on its own.
budget.tsaCountedOnce: The TSA charge is counted once — through this line — in the separation cost view.
budget.noTsa: This line carries no TSA charge.

create.title: Add a budget line
create.hint: Committed and spent amounts need the date they are as of and their source. The approved amount comes later, from a governance decision.
create.unitHint: Every amount of the line uses this currency and unit.

edit.title: Edit budget line {code}
edit.hint: Descriptive fields and the proposed amount only — never the approved amount or the state.

actuals.title: Record commitments and spend — {code}
actuals.effect: Updates the committed and/or spent amounts as of the given date, with their source, in the line's currency and unit.
actuals.committedHint: Total contractually committed to date, including what is already spent.

approval.title: Record the approved budget — {code}
approval.effect: Records the approved amount from the selected final governance decision.
approval.unitRule: The amount is in the line's currency and unit and cannot exceed the decision's amount; no conversion is applied.

costs.title: Separation cost view
costs.explain: One-off separation, recurring standalone, stranded and TSA costs, grouped per category and per currency and unit (never mixed). Each TSA charge is counted once.
costs.groupsCaption: Separation costs per category, currency and unit
costs.noTsa: No TSA service is visible to you.

recon.title: Intercompany reconciliations
recon.subtitle: Our balance against the counterparty's, in the same currency and unit. Differences stay flagged until reconciled by a reviewer who did not prepare the reconciliation.
recon.emptyHint: Record an intercompany balance, or reconcile an intercompany / opening balance figure from its page.
recon.explanationHint: Reconciling items; required before a non-zero difference can be reconciled.
recon.sameUnitHint: Must be in the same currency and unit as our balance; nothing is converted.
recon.ruleReviewer: Reconciling: a Finance member who did not prepare the reconciliation.
recon.ruleExplain: A non-zero difference needs an explanation of the reconciling items first.
recon.youPrepared: You prepared this reconciliation: separation of duties — another Finance member reviews and reconciles it.
recon.noneForFigure: No reconciliation recorded for this figure.
recon.figureHint: Our balance is the figure's amount, in its currency and unit.

create.title: Record an intercompany balance
create.hint: The counterparty balance can be added later; the source reference is mandatory.

edit.title: Edit reconciliation {code}
edit.hint: Records the counterparty balance or the explanation; the status changes only through the review commands. After a change you become the preparer.

reconcile.title: Mark {code} reconciled
reconcile.effect: Records your review: the balances agree, or the difference is explained by the recorded reconciling items.
reconcile.sod: The reviewer is a person who did not prepare the reconciliation.

dispute.title: Mark {code} disputed
dispute.effect: Records that the balance is disputed with the counterparty.

reopen.title: Reopen {code}
reopen.effect: Returns the reconciliation to open; it needs a fresh review.

models.title: Business plans & valuation
models.subtitle: References to the original models, versioned per case (base, downside, upside). Versions are frozen; a change is a new version.
models.search: Search models by code or name
models.name: Name
models.noVersionsHint: No version recorded yet: create one from the original model's outputs (proposed values), with their source.
models.emptyHint: Register a business plan or a valuation model, then record or import its versions.
models.proposedVsApproved: Proposed values are the model outputs as recorded. Approved valuation / ownership values stay empty until an approval is recorded from a final governance decision.
models.approvalNotConfigured: Approval not configured: no decision type of the authority matrix covers the approval of a business plan (to be confirmed). Business plan versions are validated here, not approved.
models.valuationApprovalRule: Approved values of a valuation version are recorded only from a final “valuation and ownership terms” governance decision, on a version validated by a human Finance user.

create.title: Register a business plan or valuation model
create.hint: The model is a reference to the original workbook; its outputs are recorded or imported as versions.

edit.title: Edit model {code}
edit.hint: Name, description and a higher classification only — versions are never edited.

versions.heading: {code} — {case} v{version} ({label})
versions.label: Version label
versions.supersededNote: A newer version of this case exists; this version stays frozen as recorded.
versions.basedOn: Starts from v{version} ({label}) of this case: its assumptions are carried over with your explicit changes.
versions.approvedEmpty: No approved values: they are recorded only when an approval from a final governance decision is recorded on a validated version.
versions.proposedHint: The outputs as recorded or imported from the original model — not approved values.
versions.findings: EV / equity, currency and unit checks
versions.noFindings: No inconsistency found between the outputs of this version.
versions.noPriorAssumptions: The prior version has no assumptions.
versions.outputsHint: Every output states its basis — the platform never guesses whether a value is enterprise value or equity value.
versions.percentNoCurrency: A percentage has no currency or unit.
versions.sourceHint: Required unless a source document is linked.
versions.diff: Assumption changes from the prior version
versions.classificationInherited: The version carries the model's classification ({classification}).
versions.approveRule: Approved values need a final “valuation and ownership terms” governance decision.

create.title: New version — {code}
create.hint: The new version is frozen at creation. The prior version of the case stays as recorded (and can no longer be approved).
create.done: Version v{version} created — assumptions added {added}, changed {changed}, removed {removed}.

import.title: Import a version from the original model — {code}
import.hint: The version keeps the source document and every output's sheet and cell reference.

validate.title: Validate version v{version}
validate.effect: Records your human financial validation of this frozen version and opens an approval request.

approve.title: Record approved values — v{version}
approve.effect: Copies the validated outputs as approved valuation / ownership values, bound to the selected final governance decision.

check.title: Consistency check
check.explain: Checks enterprise value vs equity value, currencies and units — within this version or key by key against another version. Values on different bases, in different currencies without a basis, or in different units are not compared.
check.conversionHint: Optional: a conversion basis you supply for comparing values in different currencies.
check.notValuation: A consistency check, not a professional valuation.

benefits.title: Benefits & KPIs
benefits.subtitle: Benefits register with measurement definition, baseline, target, owner, realization date and verification source; realizations are verified independently.
benefits.search: Search benefits by code or title
benefits.valueHint: Optional money estimate (currency and unit recorded as entered).
benefits.verificationSourceHint: What the realization will be verified against (report, system, statement).
benefits.realizedSameUnit: In the currency and unit of the estimated value.
benefits.noKpis: No KPI is linked to this benefit.
benefits.ruleApprove: Acceptance into the register: an independent Finance reviewer — not the creator and not the owner.
benefits.ruleVerify: Verification: a person who is neither the owner nor the reporter of the realization; never a service identity.

create.title: Register a benefit
create.hint: Baseline, target and values are entered as known — use “TBD” where they are still to be confirmed.

approve.title: Accept benefit {code} into the register
approve.effect: Accepts the benefit definition into the register.
approve.sod: You are neither the creator nor the owner of the benefit.

realization.title: Report the realization of {code}
realization.effect: Records the measured value, its date and the verification source.
realization.unverified: The realization stays unverified until someone independent verifies it.

verify.title: Verify the realization of {code}
verify.effect: Confirms the reported realization against its verification source: {source}.
verify.sod: You are neither the owner nor the reporter of the realization.

rejectRealization.title: Reject the realization of {code}
rejectRealization.effect: The reported realization is not supported by its source; the benefit returns to tracking.

cancel.title: Withdraw benefit {code}
cancel.effect: Withdraws the benefit from the register (kept in the history).

reviseDefinition.title: Reopen the definition of benefit {code}
reviseDefinition.effect: The benefit goes back to proposed: its definition, baseline, target and value can then be revised.
reviseDefinition.reaccept: It needs a fresh acceptance by an independent Finance reviewer (the previous acceptance stays in the history).

kpis.title: KPIs
kpis.subtitle: KPI definitions visible to you: {count}. A KPI without source data remains a proposal, not a historical fact.
kpis.search: Search KPIs by key or name
kpis.name: Name

create.title: Define a KPI
create.hint: Definition, formula, unit, period, source, thresholds and direction are required; targets and owners are entered only when known.

observe.title: Record an observation — {key}
observe.effect: Adds an observation with its source.
observe.appendOnly: Observations are append-only: a correction is recorded as a new observation.

errors.finance_validation_self: The preparer of a figure cannot validate it: another Finance member does.
errors.finance_approval_self: The preparer of a figure cannot approve it.
errors.finance_approval_validator: The person who validated a figure cannot also approve it: a third person does.
errors.finance_approval_not_validated: The figure has no human financial validation yet: it is validated before it can be approved.
errors.finance_approval_validation_stale: The content changed after its validation: validate the current content again.
errors.finance_approval_decision_required: An opening balance is approved by the authorized body: link its final governance decision.
errors.finance_approval_decision_not_final: The linked governance decision is not a final approval of an accepted type.
errors.finance_approval_not_requested: There is no pending approval request: validate the figure first.
errors.finance_human_required: Validation and approval are human acts; service identities can never perform them.
errors.finance_recon_self: The preparer of a reconciliation cannot review it.
errors.finance_recon_unexplained_difference: The difference is not explained yet: record the reconciling items before reconciling.
errors.finance_recon_counterparty_missing: Record the counterparty balance before reconciling.
errors.finance_recon_locked: A reconciled balance is locked: reopen it (with a reason) before changing it.
errors.finance_benefit_verify_self: The owner of the benefit or the person who reported the realization cannot verify it.
errors.finance_benefit_approve_self: The owner of the benefit cannot accept it into the register.
errors.finance_benefit_verification_source_requ: A realization needs the verification source it will be verified against.
errors.finance_model_approval_not_configured: No decision type of the authority matrix covers the approval of a business plan (to be confirmed).
errors.finance_model_superseded: A newer version of this case exists: act on the latest version.
errors.finance_model_decision_not_final: The linked decision is not a final “valuation and ownership terms” decision.
errors.finance_model_headline_basis_required: A valuation version states whether its headline value is enterprise value or equity value.
errors.finance_budget_decision_not_final: The linked decision is not a final budget decision of an accepted type.
errors.finance_budget_tsa_already_counted: This TSA charge is already carried by another budget line: it is counted once.
errors.finance_snapshot_locked: An approved figure is locked: reopen it (with a reason) before changing it.
errors.finance_snapshot_imported_locked: An imported figure keeps the value and source of its model output: import the corrected output instead.
errors.finance_snapshot_duplicate_line: A figure already exists for this line, kind and period: edit or reopen it instead.
errors.finance_double_count_category_conflict: This line reference is already recorded under another category (possible double counting).
errors.finance_double_count_tsa_line_conflict: This TSA service is already charged under another line reference.
errors.finance_double_count_line_conflict: This line reference or TSA link conflicts with an existing figure (double counting).
errors.finance_tsa_charge_link_required: A TSA charge must be linked to its TSA service so that it is counted once.
errors.money_mixed_currency: Amounts in different currencies are never combined without an explicit conversion basis.
errors.money_mixed_unit_scale: Amounts in different units (units / thousands / millions) are never combined as they are.
errors.policy_classification_exceeds_clearance: The chosen classification is above your clearance.
errors.policy_sod_subject_unknown: Separation of duties cannot be established because the preparer of this record is unknown.
errors.finance_benefit_accepted_definition_lock: The definition, baseline, target and value of an accepted benefit change only through a revision: reopen the definition (with a reason) and have it accepted again.
errors.finance_benefit_realization_pending: The definition, verification source and owner are fixed while a reported realization awaits verification.
errors.finance_budget_decision_already_used: This decision already backs the approved budget of another line: one decision backs one budget line, so the approvals recorded from it never exceed its amount.
errors.finance_budget_decision_already_recorded: This decision is already recorded as this line’s approval: a change of the approved budget needs a new decision.
errors.finance_budget_decision_amount_missing: The decision states no amount, so it sets no limit: an approved budget is recorded only from a decision whose paper states the approved amount.
errors.finance_budget_decision_unit_mismatch: The decision states its amount in another currency or unit than the line: no conversion is applied.
errors.finance_budget_exceeds_decision: The approved amount exceeds the amount of the decision.
errors.finance_budget_decision_evidence_invalid: The evidence of the external approval behind this decision is no longer valid (rejected, superseded or conflicting): it cannot back a budget approval.
errors.finance_model_decision_already_used: This decision already approved the values of another version: one decision approves the values of one version — the values of this version need their own decision.
errors.finance_model_decision_other_subject: This decision was raised for another record: it cannot approve the values of this version.
errors.finance_model_decision_evidence_invalid: The evidence of the external approval behind this decision is no longer valid (rejected, superseded or conflicting): it cannot approve valuation / ownership values.
errors.finance_approval_decision_evidence_inval: The evidence of the external approval behind this decision is no longer valid (rejected, superseded or conflicting): it cannot back this approval.

audit.benefit_approve: Accepted a benefit into the register
audit.validateModelVersion: Attempted to validate a model version
audit.verifyBenefit: Attempted to verify a benefit realization

value.ev_equity_mix: Values mix enterprise value and equity value ({evCount} EV, {equityCount} equity); confirm the bridge (net debt, adjustments) with Finance before comparing. This is a consistency check, not a professional valuation.
value.currency_mix: Values use different currencies ({currencies}); a conversion basis (rate, source, date) is required before combining them.
value.unit_mix: Values use different units ({scales}); confirm the units before comparing them.

aggregate.converted: {from} amounts converted to {to} at {rate} — source: {source}, rate date {asOf}.
aggregate.units_normalized: Units {scales} were normalized to {target} at your explicit request.
aggregate.same_basis: All {count} amounts share currency {currency} and unit {unitScale}; no conversion was applied.

budget.no_approved_budget: No approved budget is recorded for this line yet.
budget.spent_exceeds_committed: Spent ({spent}) exceeds the recorded commitments ({committed}): record the missing commitment or correct the actuals.

tsa.counted_in_line: TSA {tsaCode} is counted once, in budget line {lineCode}; its register charge is not added again.
tsa.not_in_cost_view: TSA {tsaCode} has a register charge but no budget line: it is listed here and excluded from the cost totals.
tsa.no_charge_recorded: TSA {tsaCode} has no charge recorded in the TSA register.
tsa.charge_differs: TSA {tsaCode}: the register charge differs from the commitment in budget line {lineCode}; reconcile the two.
tsa.unit_differs: TSA {tsaCode}: the register charge is in {registerCurrency} ({registerUnitScale}) but budget line {lineCode} is in {lineCurrency} ({lineUnitScale}); not compared.

double_count.tsa_multiple_lines: TSA {tsaCode} is linked from several budget lines ({lineCodes}); it is counted once (in {lineCode}).
double_count.category_conflict: Line {lineRef} is recorded under several categories ({categories}): possible double counting.

recon.counterparty_missing: {code}: the counterparty balance is not recorded yet.
recon.disputed: {code}: the balance is disputed with the counterparty.
recon.matched_pending_review: {code}: balances agree; the reconciliation awaits review.
recon.explained_difference: {code}: reconciled with an explained difference of {difference} ({currency}, {unitScale}).

compare.basis_mismatch: {key}: {basisA} is compared with {basisB}; not comparable without a documented bridge.
compare.currency_without_basis: {key}: {currencyA} vs {currencyB}; no conversion basis given, not compared.
compare.unit_mismatch: {key}: {scaleA} vs {scaleB}; mixed units are not compared.
compare.measure_mismatch: {key}: a {measureA} value is compared with a {measureB} value; not comparable.
compare.missing: {key}: present in only one of the compared versions.
